```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Prepare dataset with lag variables
crime_clean <- crime %>%
  select(Year, All.crimes, Robbery, Burglary) %>%
  mutate(
    Robbery_lag = lag(Robbery),
    Burglary_lag = lag(Burglary),
    crimes_lag = lag(All.crimes)
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

# Step 2: Base R 80/20 train-test split
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
n <- nrow(crime_clean)
train_indices <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.8 * n)
train_data <- crime_clean[train_indices, ]
test_data <- crime_clean[-train_indices, ]

# Step 3: Fit models on training data
# Linear models
model_lagged1 <- lm(Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + crimes_lag, data = train_data)
model_lagged2 <- lm(Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag, data = train_data)
model_lagged3 <- lm(Burglary ~ Burglary_lag, data = train_data)

# Log-transformed models
log_model1 <- lm(log(Burglary) ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + crimes_lag, data = train_data)
log_model2 <- lm(log(Burglary) ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag, data = train_data)
log_model3 <- lm(log(Burglary) ~ Burglary_lag, data = train_data)

# Polynomial models (degree 2)
poly_model1 <- lm(Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE), data = train_data)
poly_model2 <- lm(Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + Burglary_lag + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE), data = train_data)
poly_model3 <- lm(Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE), data = train_data)
# Predict on test set
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Pred_poly1 = predict(poly_model1, newdata = .),
    Pred_poly2 = predict(poly_model2, newdata = .),
    Pred_poly3 = predict(poly_model3, newdata = .)
  )

# Step 4: Make predictions on test set
test_data <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    Actual = Burglary,
    Predicted1 = predict(model_lagged1, newdata = .),
    Predicted2 = predict(model_lagged2, newdata = .),
    Predicted3 = predict(model_lagged3, newdata = .),
    Pred_log1 = exp(predict(log_model1, newdata = .)),
    Pred_log2 = exp(predict(log_model2, newdata = .)),
    Pred_log3 = exp(predict(log_model3, newdata = .))
  )

plot_data <- test_data %>%
  select(Year, Actual, Predicted1, Predicted2, Predicted3,
         Pred_log1, Pred_log2, Pred_log3,
         Pred_poly1, Pred_poly2, Pred_poly3) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Year, names_to = "Model", values_to = "Burglary")

# Update color scale
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Year, y = Burglary, color = Model, linetype = Model)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Test Set: Actual vs Predicted Burglary (Linear, Log, Poly Models)",
    y = "Burglary Rate per 100,000",
    color = "Model",
    linetype = "Model"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Actual" = "black",
    "Predicted1" = "red",
    "Predicted2" = "blue",
    "Predicted3" = "green",
    "Pred_log1" = "orange",
    "Pred_log2" = "purple",
    "Pred_log3" = "brown",
    "Pred_poly1" = "pink",
    "Pred_poly2" = "darkcyan",
    "Pred_poly3" = "goldenrod"
  )) +
  theme_minimal()
# RMSE Function
rmse_func <- function(actual, predicted) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))
}

# Compute RMSE
rmse_results <- tibble(
  Model = c("lm1", "lm2", "lm3", "log1", "log2", "log3"),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Predicted1),
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Predicted2),
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Predicted3),
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_log1),
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_log2),
    rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_log3)
  )
)
rmse_results <- rmse_results %>%
  add_row(
    Model = c("poly1", "poly2", "poly3"),
    RMSE = c(
      rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_poly1),
      rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_poly2),
      rmse_func(test_data$Actual, test_data$Pred_poly3)
    )
  )

print(rmse_results)

print(rmse_results)

```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(broom)

# 1. Create 5-fold cross-validation sets
set.seed(42)
cv_folds <- crossv_kfold(crime_clean, k = 5)

# 2. Define model formulas
formulas <- tibble(
  model_name = c("lm1", "lm2", "poly1", "poly2", "poly3"),
  formula = list(
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + crimes_lag,
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag,
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE),
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE),
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE)
  )
)
# Expand folds and formulas into all combinations
cv_grid <- crossing(cv_folds, formulas)

# Fit model, make predictions, calculate RMSE
cv_results <- cv_grid %>%
  mutate(
    train = map(train, as_tibble),
    test  = map(test, as_tibble),
    
    model = map2(train, formula, ~lm(.y, data = .x)),
    preds = map2(model, test, ~predict(.x, newdata = .y)),
    rmse  = map2_dbl(test, preds, ~sqrt(mean((.x$Burglary - .y)^2, na.rm = TRUE)))
  )
cv_summary <- cv_results %>%
  group_by(model_name) %>%
  summarise(mean_rmse = mean(rmse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_rmse)

print(cv_summary)
ggplot(cv_summary, aes(x = reorder(model_name, mean_rmse), y = mean_rmse)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue",) +
  labs(title = "5-Fold CV RMSE for Selected Models",
       x = "Model",
       y = "Mean RMSE") +
  theme_minimal()

```




```{r}
data_clean = data %>% select(date.aired,motive,arrested,culprit.gender,culprit.amount,network) %>% mutate(Year = year(date.aired),motive = fct_collapse(
      motive,
      Stealing = c("Natural Resource", "Treasure", "Theft", "Inheritance")
    ),
    # Then lump all other motives (not "Stealing") into "Other"
    motive = fct_other(motive, keep = "Stealing", other_level = "Other")) 
data_clean_motive = data_clean%>% group_by(Year,motive) %>% summarise(culprit_total = sum(culprit.amount)) %>% ungroup()

all_years <- seq(min(data_clean$Year), max(data_clean$Year))

data_clean_motive_filled = data_clean_motive %>%
  complete(
    Year = all_years,
    motive,
    fill = list(culprit_total = 0)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = motive,
    values_from = culprit_total,
    values_fill = list(culprit_total = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = Stealing + Other,
    percent_stealing = if_else(total > 0, (Stealing / total) * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(Year, percent_stealing) %>% ungroup()


data_clean_motive_filled
dcm = data_clean_motive_filled[11:52,]
dcm
```

```{r}
data_clean = data %>% select(date.aired,arrested,culprit.amount,network)%>% mutate(Year = year(date.aired))
data_clean_arrest = data_clean%>% group_by(Year,arrested) %>% summarise(culprit_total = sum(culprit.amount)) %>% ungroup()

data_filled <- data_clean_arrest %>%
  complete(
    Year = all_years,
    arrested,
    fill = list(culprit_total = 0)
  )

# Pivot wider: separate arrested TRUE and FALSE columns
data_clean_arrest_filled <- data_filled %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = arrested,
    values_from = culprit_total,
    values_fill = list(culprit_total = 0)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    arrested_false = `FALSE`,
    arrested_true = `TRUE`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = arrested_false + arrested_true,
    percent_arrested = if_else(total > 0, (arrested_true / total) * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  select(Year, percent_arrested)


dca = data_clean_arrest_filled[12:52,]
dca
scooby_factors = inner_join(dcm,dca, by = "Year") %>% mutate(arrest_lag = lag(percent_arrested),stealing_lag = lag(percent_stealing))
scooby_factors

crime_scooby = inner_join(scooby_factors,crime_clean_model,by = "Year")

crime_scooby
```

```{r}
formulas <- list(
  model1 = Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag,
  model2 = Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE),
  model3 = Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + arrest_lag + stealing_lag,
  model4 = Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + stealing_lag,
  model5 = Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + arrest_lag,
  model6 = Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(arrest_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(stealing_lag, 2, raw=TRUE),
  model7 = Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(arrest_lag, 2, raw=TRUE),
  model8 = Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(stealing_lag, 2, raw=TRUE)
)
set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(crime_scooby)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = 0.8 * n)
train_data <- crime_scooby[train_idx, ]
test_data <- crime_scooby[-train_idx, ]
models_fitted <- map(formulas, ~lm(.x, data = train_data))

test_preds <- map(models_fitted, ~predict(.x, newdata = test_data))
plot_df <- test_data %>%
  select(Year, Burglary) %>%
  mutate(Actual = Burglary) %>%
  bind_cols(as_tibble(test_preds)) %>%
  rename_with(~names(formulas), -c(Year, Burglary, Actual)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(names(formulas)), names_to = "Model", values_to = "Predicted")
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Year)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual, color = "Actual"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Predicted, color = Model), linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Test Set: Actual vs Predicted Burglary by Model",
       y = "Burglary Rate per 100,000",
       color = "Legend") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "black",
                                "model1" = "red",
                                "model2" = "blue",
                                "model3" = "green",
                                "model4" = "purple",
                                "model5" = "orange",
                                "model6" = "brown",
                                "model7" = "pink",
                                "model8" = "darkcyan")) +
  theme_minimal()
rmse_func <- function(actual, predicted) sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

rmse_results <- map_dbl(test_preds, ~rmse_func(test_data$Burglary, .x))

rmse_table <- tibble(
  Model = names(formulas),
  RMSE = rmse_results
)

print(rmse_table)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(broom)

# 1. Create 5-fold CV splits
set.seed(121)
cv_folds <- crossv_kfold(crime_scooby, k = 5)

# 2. Define your 8 formulas in a tibble
formulas <- tibble(
  model_name = c("model1", "model2", "model3", "model4", "model5", "model6", "model7", "model8"),
  formula = list(
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag,
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE),
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + arrest_lag + stealing_lag,
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + stealing_lag,
    Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag + arrest_lag,
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(arrest_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + poly(stealing_lag, 2, raw=TRUE),
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(arrest_lag, 2, raw=TRUE),
    Burglary ~ poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + poly(stealing_lag, 2, raw=TRUE)
  )
)

# 3. Cross join folds with formulas
cv_grid <- crossing(cv_folds, formulas)

# 4. Nest train and test sets
cv_grid <- cv_grid %>%
  mutate(
    train_data = map(train, as_tibble),
    test_data  = map(test, as_tibble)
  )

# 5. Fit models on train, predict on test, calculate RMSE
cv_grid <- cv_grid %>%
  mutate(
    model = map2(train_data, formula, ~lm(.y, data = .x)),
    preds = map2(model, test_data, ~predict(.x, newdata = .y)),
    rmse = map2_dbl(test_data, preds, ~sqrt(mean((.x$Burglary - .y)^2, na.rm = TRUE)))
  )

# 6. Summarize mean RMSE by model
cv_summary <- cv_grid %>%
  group_by(model_name) %>%
  summarise(mean_rmse = mean(rmse), sd_rmse = sd(rmse), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(mean_rmse)

print(cv_summary)
ggplot(cv_summary, aes(x = reorder(model_name, mean_rmse), y = mean_rmse)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_rmse - sd_rmse, ymax = mean_rmse + sd_rmse), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "5-Fold CV RMSE for Models",
       x = "Model",
       y = "Mean RMSE ± SD") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
model_simple <- lm(Burglary ~ Robbery_lag + Burglary_lag, data = crime_scooby)

model_poly <- lm(Burglary ~ 
                   poly(Robbery_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + 
                   poly(Burglary_lag, 1, raw=TRUE) + 
                   poly(crimes_lag, 3, raw=TRUE) + 
                   poly(arrest_lag, 2, raw=TRUE) + 
                   poly(stealing_lag, 2, raw=TRUE), data = crime_scooby)
crime_scooby_preds <- crime_scooby %>%
  mutate(
    Actual = Burglary,
    Pred_Simple = predict(model_simple, newdata = .),
    Pred_Poly = predict(model_poly, newdata = .)
  ) %>%
  select(Year, Actual, Pred_Simple, Pred_Poly) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Actual", "Pred_Simple", "Pred_Poly"), names_to = "Type", values_to = "Burglary")

ggplot(crime_scooby_preds, aes(x = Year, y = Burglary, color = Type, linetype = Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    Actual = "black",
    Pred_Simple = "red",
    Pred_Poly = "blue"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    Actual = "solid",
    Pred_Simple = "dashed",
    Pred_Poly = "dotted"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual vs Predicted Burglary Over Years",
    y = "Burglary Rate per 100,000",
    color = "Legend",
    linetype = "Legend"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
